posture: Refute, do not confirm. Every claim was tested against live repository bytes — live COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md, live file 08, the live d9 exit contract, the live G10 and G23 occupancy occupancies, the live sarif leftover-join.v7, the live frozen fixtures/sarif-fc-nonauth-term.v1/ payloads, the live fixtures/sarif-fc-nonauth-term.v2/ tree and the live git object store — never against the subject's account of itself. Every path/sha256 pair carried anywhere in the subject was recomputed from disk mechanically rather than sampled. Quoted strings were tested by literal substring containment in the cited source file, not read for plausibility. Ordered lists claimed ORDERED-EQUAL were compared as ordered sequences, not as sets. Cited commits were resolved in the object store, not accepted as tokens. The frozen predecessor sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v3 was structurally diffed against the subject to establish exactly what the successor changed, what it added, and what it carried over untouched, and the sibling copy-act g29-fixture-corpus.v2 (D-342) and the recorded practice g21-fixture-corpus.v8 (D-247) were read to test whether the subject's wording forms are the already-accepted forms or novel ones.

scopeOfAccept: This ACCEPT is a Stage A design-review verdict on sarif-fc-nonauth-term-golden.v4 as leftover-design fixture authoring under D-056 Decision 5. It is not a recording, not an application, not a seal, and not evidence of DR-122 execution or SATISFIED grade. It accepts that eight per-D-002-platform copies exist byte-equal to the two frozen D-296 payloads on four platforms quoted ORDERED-EQUAL from G10 occupancy v2 and corroborated against G23 occupancy v2, that the subject's every cited digest matches live bytes, and that the subject performs none of the acts it disclaims. leftover-design of OBL-FC-NONAUTH-TERM-FX remains open on sarif leftover-join.v7; whether it is stale as an authoring claim after this cycle is for a later leftover-join remasurement to measure.
rationale: The subject is a narrow copy act with a wide disclaimer surface, and both halves survived attack. The copy half is mechanically true: eight files exist on disk at the claimed paths, each byte-equal to its frozen v1 source, at 0444 under 0755 directories named by the recorded slash-to-dash transliteration, on exactly the four platforms the current recorded join already quotes and in that order, with no Windows cell and no ninth file. The quotation half is lawful rather than inventive: the DR-122 lineage genuinely carries no platforms array in any of its six artifacts, the source occupancy is pinned by path and digest and verified live, the ORDERED-EQUAL corroboration against G23 holds as an ordered comparison, and the Windows deferral is character-for-character the upstream text. The disclaimer half is honest: 54 recordedInputs digests and 67 embedded path/digest pairs all reproduce from disk, all eight cited commits resolve to the decisions their roles describe, all eight cited COORD headings exist at the claimed subjects, required-now is independently confirmed at 28 in both file 08 and D-343's own body, and every foreign-lineage does-not-remasure token names a version that exists and is current. The speaker discipline holds throughout — no deictic version reference, no bare leftover-join token, a single last-heading claimant — and the two wording forms that looked chargeable on first read (OBS-1's present-tense predecessor clause and OBS-5's clipped verbatim) turn out to be the exact forms already accepted under recording at D-342 and D-296. Nothing was left to charge.
verdictStatement: ACCEPT — 0 blockers, 0 MUST-FIX, 0 SHOULD-FIX, 6 observations that travel as honesty work and charge nothing.
